zh.lightweightTagTitle: 创建本地轻量标签（非附注标签）
zh.lightweightTagScope: 仅 Git 工作区。从服务端固定的当前 HEAD 创建直接指向提交的轻量标签，不创建 tag 对象，无标签者或消息。严格配置拒绝 hooks、packed-refs、过滤器等不支持状态；不覆盖、不签名、不 push、不 checkout，不修改工作文件或 index。
zh.lightweightTagBounds: 输入原样可移植短名称：总长最多 1000 UTF-8 字节，每分量最多 255 字节；拒绝 HEAD、refs/、控制字符及 Windows 保留名。不自动规范化，无 OID / ref、标签者或消息输入。候选有效期最多 61 秒。
zh.lightweightTagPrepare: 只读生成轻量标签候选
zh.lightweightTagConfirm: 最终确认创建轻量标签
zh.lightweightTagAcknowledge: 我已核对完整候选，确认创建直接指向固定 HEAD 提交的轻量标签（不创建 tag 对象）
zh.lightweightTagTarget: 直接目标提交（无 tag 对象）
zh.lightweightTagCurrentRef: 当前分支引用（保持不变）
zh.lightweightTagWarning: 轻量标签直接指向提交，不是附注标签，不创建 tag 对象，无标签者或消息。不覆盖、不签名、不 push、不 checkout；HEAD 及当前分支不变。不保证全局外部原子性，不自动重试或回滚。
zh.lightweightTagPending: 轻量标签确认已发送，等待核对。
zh.lightweightTagUnknown: 轻量标签 / 仓库写入结果未知；取消、离开或断连不保证撤销。禁止自动重试、覆盖或回滚，请显式重新发现并核对 refs 和 HEAD 后再写入。
zh.lightweightTagRecover: 核对 refs / HEAD 后显式重新发现
zh.lightweightTagInvalid: 轻量标签响应无效或与固定候选及原样名称不一致。
zh.lightweightTagInvalidDraft: 请输入原样可移植短名称（总长 1000 / 每分量 255 UTF-8 字节）。
zh.lightweightTagExpired: 轻量标签候选已过期，请显式重新生成，不自动重试。
zh.lightweightTagConfirmation: 核对固定轻量标签候选
zh.lightweightTagCancel: 取消轻量标签候选 / 等待
zh.tagCreateScope: 仅 Git 工作区，从服务端固定的当前 HEAD 创建无签名附注标签。严格配置拒绝 hooks、packed-refs、过滤器等不支持状态。不覆盖、不签名、不 push、不 checkout，不修改工作文件或 index。
zh.tagCreateBounds: 原样短名称总长最多 1000 UTF-8 字节，每分量最多 255 字节；身份姓名/邮箱各最多 1024 字节，显式填写非负安全整数 Unix 秒和 ±HHMM 时区（最多 ±1400）。非空消息最多 65536 UTF-8 字节，保留 CR/LF/TAB，拒绝其他控制字符和 PGP 签名标记。候选有效期最多 61 秒。不自动获取或复用身份，不自动规范化。
zh.tagCreateAcknowledge: 我已核对完整候选，确认仅在当前 HEAD 创建无签名附注标签
zh.tagCreateCurrentRef: 当前分支引用（保持不变）
zh.tagCreateWarning: 仅创建无签名附注标签，不覆盖、不签名、不 push、不 checkout。目标固定为预览 HEAD，HEAD 及当前分支不变。不保证全局外部原子性，不自动重试或回滚。
zh.tagCreatePending: 创建标签确认已发送，等待核对。
zh.tagCreateUnknown: 创建结果未知；禁止重试。请先核对标签 refs 和 HEAD，再显式刷新/重新发现。
zh.tagCreateInvalid: 标签候选或结果无效，或与原样提交的名称、身份、消息不匹配。
zh.tagCreateInvalidDraft: 请输入可移植短名称、显式完整身份（含 Unix 秒及 ±HHMM）和非空严格 UTF-8 消息。
zh.tagCreateExpired: 标签候选已过期，请显式重新生成。
zh.tagCreateCancel: 取消 / 清除标签候选
zh.branchDeletePreviewTitle: 本地分支删除只读评估（未执行删除）
zh.branchDeletePreviewScope: 仅 Git 工作区的只读评估，不执行删除、不提供强制删除或实际删除功能。未合并分支及不支持的仓库状态会被拒绝，不绕过拒绝。
zh.branchDeletePreviewBounds: 输入原样短名称，不自动规范化；总长最多 1000 UTF-8 字节，每个路径分量最多 255 字节。
zh.branchDeletePreviewConstraints: 仅支持后端严格验证的当前分支和直接 loose 目标引用；packed-refs、共享元数据、hooks 等不支持状态会拒绝。观察屏障不是全局原子快照，不能防止原始引用类型竞态或修改后恢复。
zh.branchDeletePreviewInvalidDraft: 请输入可移植的原样短分支名称（总长 1000 / 每分量 255 UTF-8 字节）。
zh.branchDeletePreviewInvalid: 分支评估响应无效或与提交名称不一致。
zh.branchDeletePreviewBlocked: 仓库写入进行中或结果未知；暂不评估，避免陈旧状态。
zh.branchDeletePreviewWarning: 未执行删除。已合并证明不是删除许可，不授予任何权限，也不保证后续引用状态不变。
zh.branchDeletePreviewCount: 证明路径 OID 数量
zh.branchDeletePreviewPath: 展开证明路径（当前 → 目标）
zh.branchDeletePreviewCancel: 取消评估 / 清除结果
zh.branchCreateScope: 仅 Git 工作区。严格配置拒绝 hooks、packed-refs、过滤器等不支持状态，不绕过拒绝；不覆盖已有分支。只从当前固定 HEAD 创建本地引用，不自动 checkout，不修改工作文件或 index。
zh.branchCreateBounds: 输入原样短名称：总长最多 1000 UTF-8 字节，每个路径分量最多 255 字节；拒绝 HEAD、refs/、控制字符、Windows 保留名和不可移植名称。候选有效期最多 61 秒；无 OID / ref 输入，不自动规范化。
zh.branchCreateAcknowledge: 我已核对完整分支候选，确认仅创建且不切换分支
zh.branchCreateCurrentRef: 当前分支引用（保持不变）
zh.branchCreateWarning: 仅创建新分支，不覆盖、不 checkout 或自动切换；HEAD 及当前分支保持不变。不保证全局外部原子性。不自动重试或回滚。
zh.branchCreatePending: 创建分支确认已发送，等待核对。
zh.branchCreateConfirmation: 核对固定分支创建候选
zh.branchCreateExpired: 候选已过期丢弃；请显式重新生成，不自动重试。
zh.branchCreateInvalid: 分支创建响应无效或与固定候选不一致。
zh.branchCreateInvalidDraft: 请输入有效且可移植的原样短分支名称（总长 1000 / 每分量 255 UTF-8 字节）。
zh.branchCreateUnknown: 创建分支 / 仓库写入结果未知。取消、离开或断连不保证撤销；不自动重试、覆盖或回滚。请显式重新发现并检查 refs 和 HEAD 后再写入。
zh.branchCreateRecover: 显式重新发现并检查 refs / HEAD
zh.branchCreateCancel: 取消分支候选 / 等待
zh.amendTitle: 显式 amend — 重写历史（不是新增子提交）
zh.amendScope: 仅 Git 已加载的暂存索引；空变更列表也允许仅改消息。保留原作者和全部父提交（根提交为零个），不接受客户端输入这两项。严格后端拒绝签名提交、packed-refs、hooks、过滤器 / 编码转换、attributes、链接、子模块、冲突和其他不支持状态，不绕过拒绝。
zh.amendDefaults: 显式填写提交者四字段及纯文本消息。姓名邮箱初始空白；浏览器时间和时区可编辑。不查找身份、不自动加载原消息。姓名 / 邮箱各限 1024 UTF-8 字节，消息限 65536 字节，最多 16 个不重复父提交，候选最多有效 61 秒。
zh.amendWarning: 重写历史：替换当前分支 HEAD，不是新增子提交。核对旧 HEAD、原树、原作者、全部父提交、新树和替换提交。预检 / 取消不写对象；确认仅追加（append-only）对象后更新分支，不改工作文件或 index。可能留下孤立对象；不保证全局外部原子性，不自动重试、重跑、回滚、GC 或强制推送（force-push）。
zh.amendPrepare: 只读生成 amend 候选
zh.amendAcknowledge: 我已核对完整替换候选，并明确同意重写当前分支历史
zh.amendRoot: 根提交 — 零个父提交
zh.amendClearDraft: 显式清空 amend 草稿
zh.amendCancel: 取消 amend 候选 / 等待
zh.amendPending: 已发送 amend 最终确认，等待核对。
zh.amendConfirmation: 核对固定重写历史候选
zh.amendExpired: 过期候选已丢弃，不自动重试；请显式重新生成。
zh.amendInvalid: amend 响应无效或与捕获候选不一致。
zh.amendInvalidDraft: 请显式填写有效提交者四字段及受限纯文本消息。
zh.amendUnknown: amend 结果未知。不自动重试、重跑、回滚或强制推送。请显式重新发现并核对 HEAD、分支和索引后再写入。
zh.amendRecover: 显式重新发现并核对仓库
zh.commitLatestScope: 仅显式读取当前分支固定 HEAD 的提交，不改草稿、候选或确认。
zh.commitLatestInvalid: 最新提交响应无效或超出安全边界。
zh.commitLatestReuseNotice: 仅显式复用消息原文（包括 CRLF、BOM 和空消息），不复用作者或提交者。将创建全新提交，不是 amend。写入策略不支持的原文保留在草稿，但生成候选将拒绝；不自动规范化换行。
zh.commitPending: 最终确认已发送，等待核对。
zh.commitAcknowledge: 我已核对完整候选、显式身份及原文消息，确认更新当前分支
zh.commitRecover: 显式重新发现并核对仓库
zh.commitExpired: 令牌已过期丢弃，未自动重试；请重新生成候选。
zh.commitInvalid: 提交响应无效或与捕获候选不一致。
zh.commitInvalidDraft: 请输入姓名和邮箱（各最多 1024 UTF-8 字节，无控制字符或尖括号）、非负安全整数 epoch 秒、±HHMM 时区（最大 ±1400，分钟小于 60）、非空纯文本消息（最多 64 KiB，只允许 LF 和 tab 控制字符）。
zh.commitDefaults: 姓名与邮箱默认为空，不读取 Git 配置或自动请求身份。时间默认值仅来自浏览器 epoch 秒和时区，作者与提交者独立可编辑，必须核对表单和预览。保留消息原文和末尾换行。
zh.commitScope: 仅支持 Git 普通已暂存索引修改、新增、删除，不是暂存全部、amend 或 push。严格后端拒绝签名父提交、packed-refs、hooks、过滤器 / 编码转换、attributes、链接、子模块、冲突和其他不支持状态。不绕过拒绝，不承诺对所有外部进程全局原子。
zh.commitWarning: 只读预检与取消候选不会写对象。最终确认复验固定 HEAD、分支、索引摘要和元数据；仅追加（append-only）写 tree/commit 对象并更新分支，不修改工作文件或索引。失败 / 取消可能留下孤立对象，不执行 GC、回滚或自动重试；不保证全局外部原子性。
zh.commitUnknown: 提交 / 索引确认结果未知。发送确认后取消、离开或断连不保证撤销，append-only 孤立对象可能保留。显式刷新并检查 HEAD 和 index 后再准备；不得自动重试或回滚。
zh.indexMutationPending: 此仓库已有 HEAD / 索引确认请求或结果未知。请等待，并显式刷新核对 HEAD 和 index。
zh.partialUnstagePlan: 新建 / 重新规划取消暂存块
zh.partialUnstageScope: 支持 Git 已暂存普通修改（M 空格或 MM）；当前 Index → 固定 HEAD 反向恢复所选块，保留未选索引变更及工作文件，不编辑工作区。整文件取消暂存仍拒绝 MM。不支持二进制、无效 UTF-8、增删、重命名、链接、子模块、过滤器及 Git attributes。每侧最多 256 KiB、4000 行、4000 个精确块，精确 LCS 最多 200000 格；全工作树扫描每文件最多 2 MiB、合计 16 MiB，超限拒绝。
zh.partialUnstageReadonly: 规划与选择预览均为只读，不写对象或索引。仅可整块选择原始行；替换块原子应用，不允许任意行编辑。行号从 1 开始；⟦LF⟧、⟦CRLF⟧、⟦CR⟧ 为原始换行，⟦NONE⟧ 表示无末尾换行。
zh.partialUnstageDeleted: 删除当前 Index 原始行
zh.partialUnstageConsumed: 规划已消耗；选择已锁定。要修改选择必须新建规划，原确认令牌将被丢弃。
zh.partialUnstageWarning: 核对 Index → HEAD 恢复块、完整对象 ID 和模式。候选是从捕获的当前 Index 与固定 HEAD 原始字节生成的合成索引 blob，不是工作文件字节，也不一定等于 HEAD blob。仅最终确认写索引并以仅追加（append-only）方式保存 blob；即使是取消暂存，取消或失败也可能留下孤立 blob，不执行 GC 或回滚。确认复验工作区，变化必须重新规划；不编辑工作文件或 HEAD。发送确认后取消或离开不保证撤销。
zh.partialUnstageAcknowledge: 我已核对 Index → HEAD 恢复块及合成候选索引，确认仅取消所选块暂存
zh.partialUnstageConfirm: 最终确认取消所选块暂存
zh.partialUnstageExpired: 令牌已过期，未发送写请求；请新建规划。
zh.partialUnstageInvalid: 块取消暂存响应无效或超出安全边界；请新建规划。
zh.partialUnstageTarget: 合成候选目标索引条目
zh.partialPlan: 新建 / 重新规划变更块
zh.partialScope: 支持 Git 未暂存普通修改（空格 M 或 MM）；始终基于当前 Index 规划剩余工作变更，保留已有暂存。整文件操作仍拒绝 MM；不支持二进制、无效 UTF-8、增删、重命名、链接、子模块、过滤器及 Git attributes。每侧最多 256 KiB、4000 行、4000 个精确变更块，去除公共首尾后的精确 LCS 最多 200000 格；仓库扫描每文件最多 2 MiB、合计 16 MiB（含忽略和未跟踪文件）。超限拒绝，不静默截断。
zh.partialReadonly: 规划与选择预览均为只读，不写对象或索引。仅可整块选择原始行；替换块原子应用，不允许任意行编辑。行号从 1 开始；⟦LF⟧、⟦CRLF⟧、⟦CR⟧ 为原始换行，⟦NONE⟧ 表示无末尾换行。
zh.partialConsumed: 规划已消耗；选择已锁定。要修改选择必须新建规划，原确认令牌将被丢弃。
zh.partialWarning: 核对所选块、完整对象 ID 与模式后才确认。候选仅由规划捕获的所选原子块生成；确认会重新读取并复验工作区，内容变化须重新规划，不以实时内容替代候选。不修改工作文件或 HEAD。只有最终确认会以仅追加方式保存 blob；取消或失败可能留下孤立 blob，不执行 GC 或回滚。发送确认后取消或离开页面不保证撤销。
zh.partialAcknowledge: 我已核对精确原始块及候选索引，确认仅暂存所选块
zh.partialExpired: 令牌已过期，未发送写请求；请新建规划。
zh.partialInvalid: 块暂存响应无效或超出安全边界；请新建规划。
zh.stageScope: 仅支持 Git 未暂存模式中普通已修改文件（空格 M），不支持 MM 或部分暂存、增删、重命名、子模块及链接。预检扫描整个工作树（含忽略和未跟踪文件），每文件最多 2 MiB、合计最多 16 MiB；不支持过滤器和 Git attributes。服务端拒绝不支持的仓库；不会静默跳过限制。
zh.stageWarning: 确认后仅将此文件预检捕获的字节写入索引，不读取更新后的工作文件；不修改工作文件或 HEAD。请核对完整对象 ID 与模式。预检与取消预检不会写对象；发送确认后会以仅追加方式保存 blob，此后取消可能留下未引用的孤立 blob，不执行 GC 或回滚。请求发出后取消或离开页面不保证撤销。
zh.stageTarget: 捕获字节的目标索引条目
zh.stageAcknowledge: 我已核对预检信息，确认仅暂存此文件捕获的字节
zh.stageExpired: 确认已过期，未发送写请求；请重新预检。
zh.stagePending: 暂存请求已发出；请勿重复操作。
zh.stageUnknown: 提交 / 索引操作结果未知；令牌已作废，不会重试。所有提交、暂存与取消暂存均已阻止。仅追加（append-only）孤立对象可能保留，不执行回滚。请显式刷新同一实际仓库，检查 HEAD 和 index 后再决定后续操作。
zh.unstageScope: 仅支持 Git 已暂存模式中普通已修改文件（M 空格），不支持 MM 或部分暂存、增删、重命名、子模块及链接。预检扫描整个工作树（含忽略和未跟踪文件），每文件最多 2 MiB、合计最多 16 MiB；不支持过滤器和 Git attributes。服务端拒绝不支持的仓库；不会静默跳过限制。
zh.unstageWarning: 确认后仅将此文件的索引恢复到 HEAD，不修改工作文件或 HEAD。请核对独立预检中的完整对象 ID 与模式；请求发出后取消或离开页面不保证撤销。
zh.unstageTarget: 目标 HEAD 索引条目
zh.unstageAcknowledge: 我已核对预检信息，确认仅取消此文件暂存
zh.unstageExpired: 确认已过期，未发送写请求；请重新预检。
zh.unstagePending: 取消暂存请求已发出；请勿重复操作。
zh.unstageUnknown: 提交 / 索引操作结果未知；令牌已作废，不会重试。所有提交、暂存与取消暂存均已阻止。仅追加（append-only）孤立对象可能保留，不执行回滚。请显式刷新同一实际仓库，检查 HEAD 和 index 后再决定后续操作。
zh.reflogScope: 只读查看本地引用日志快照，最多 200 条，不分页。点击记录读取该记录返回的固定提交，不随引用移动。这里只提供查看，不提供恢复、重置或任何写操作。
zh.reflogTruncated: 引用日志超过显示上限，仅返回最近 200 条；这不是完整日志。
zh.reflogEmpty: 没有可用的引用日志记录。
zh.reflogInvalid: 引用日志响应无效，请重试。
zh.grepPageLimit: 已达到本页显示容量，可继续读取。
zh.grepScanBudget: 已达到本页扫描容量，可继续扫描。
zh.grepUnsupported: 存在超过文件容量限制的内容，未包含在结果中。
zh.grepTextTruncated: 命中行较长，仅显示开头片段；打开文件查看命中内容。
zh.segmentLocalCoordinates: 仅显示片段内行号；此宿主未提供全局行坐标，无法定位目标行。
zh.grepInvalid: 搜索响应无效或快照发生变化，请重新查询。
zh.grepComplete: 固定快照已搜索完毕；数量仅表示本页。
zh.grepMoreAvailable: 尚未搜索完毕，可继续下一页；数量仅表示本页。
zh.grepPartial: 搜索结束，但部分内容受限或被跳过；结果不完整。
zh.grepEmptyPage: 本页没有匹配，仍有内容可继续搜索。
zh.readingTargetMissing: 目标行不在当前可用文本中
zh.segmentPartialLine: 段首或段尾可能仅包含一行的部分内容
zh.reviewWithBranchSwitch: 只读审阅 · Git 操作需确认
zh.branchSwitcher: 切换本地 Git 分支
zh.branchScope: 这是实际工作区操作，不是历史筛选。仅支持已有本地分支；必须先读取并预检，核对来源及目标提交后再次确认。会修改 HEAD、索引及工作文件；不强制、不自动暂存、不创建分支、不联网。脏状态或不支持的仓库由服务端拒绝。
zh.branchWarning: 确认后会修改当前仓库的实际分支、索引及工作文件。请先保存编辑器内容。仅当前确认信息有效，不自动重试；切换进行中离开页面也不能保证撤销。
zh.branchExpired: 确认已过期；未发送切换请求。请重新预检。
zh.branchPending: 切换请求已发出；请勿重复操作或离开页面。
zh.branchUnknown: 无法确认切换结果。此令牌已作废，不会自动重试。请重新读取实际仓库并刷新工作区，再决定后续操作。
zh.branchRecover: 重新读取并刷新工作区
zh.branchInvalid: 分支响应不完整或无效；请重新读取。
zh.svnOfferExpired: 网络访问提案已过期；请手动重试，并重新勾选同意。
zh.svnExpired: SVN 网络授权已过期，历史请求已停止；请重新审阅并同意。
zh.svnConsentReview: 审阅 SVN 网络访问范围
zh.svnConsentScope: 同意前仅读取本地身份。授权只适用于所列仓库、Session 与目录，五分钟有效；不授权重定向或写操作。
zh.svnConsentExplicit: 我同意访问以上 HTTPS SVN 仓库
zh.svnHistoryScope: 固定 revision 快照的 SVN 历史；保留最近 200 条，可加载更多或返回
zh.svnHistoryDateScope: 按日期（svn:date 的日期部分）在已加载窗口内有界过滤；SVN REPORT 仅支持 revision 区间，故不宣称跨窗口完整扫描。
zh.svnCopyOutside: 复制来源在授权范围外，不能打开
zh.svnCopyTraceScope: 单独查看范围内固定来源，仍止于其复制边界；不是自动追溯
zh.svnTraceScope: 文件追溯在复制边界停止，不跟随范围外来源
zh.svnGrantScope: 网络授权五分钟有效；可随时撤销，历史操作不修改工作副本。
zh.svnRevoke: 撤销 SVN 网络授权
zh.svnIdentity: 查看 SVN 本地历史访问身份
zh.svnOfflineIdentity: 仅从授权工作副本读取本地元数据，不发起远程请求。
zh.svnRemoteDisabled: 远程 SVN 历史传输尚未启用；没有网络授权或可用访问凭据。本页不是已授权历史入口。
zh.historyWindow: 已加载历史窗口（序号左闭右开）
zh.historyWindowScope: 列表及图最多保留200条；继续加载替换较新行，跨窗口边不表示完整图。局部筛选仅当前窗口。
zh.segmentScope: 仅固定历史 UTF-8 普通文件，最大 16 MiB；每片最多 64 KiB，替换显示不累积。显示原文件全局行号，可定位目标行；片段边界可能在行中间，不是全文件 Diff。
zh.fileHistoryMergeBoundary: 身份边界：合并提交，此处停止，不推断多父来源
zh.fileHistoryAmbiguous: 多个候选来源，此处停止追溯
zh.fileHistoryRenameLimit: 已达32次重命名确认上限，此处停止
zh.fileHistoryBoundary: 身份边界：复制或非精确重命名，此处停止
zh.fileHistoryFollowScope: 跟随Git检出的重命名；50%以上相似重命名额外确认唯一删除／新增来源，歧义、复制和合并处停止。相似度不是身份保证；每条记录使用当时路径。
zh.graphLaneLimit: 泳道最多32条；超出部分省略图形，完整已加载节点与关系仍可在文字中查看。
zh.historyBranchScope: 引用由下方手动加载；选择后固定该次OID，刷新引用不会移动历史起点。选择HEAD重新读取当前HEAD，不切换工作区。
zh.historyServerScope: 查询固定快照可达的完整历史；说明/作者为忽略大小写的字面匹配，路径为精确路径或目录，不追踪重命名。时间边界按提交时间(committer date)过滤且含边界，使用 --since-as-filter 避免非单调历史被提前截断；无时区按运行机器本地时区解释。分页与运行时间有界。
zh.title: VCS 变更
zh.noSession: 先打开一个项目会话，再查看变更。
zh.noRepo: 未发现 Git / SVN 仓库。可输入相对子目录后重新扫描。
zh.conflictStagesScope: 手动读取所选冲突的 Index 阶段1／2／3；阶段编号只表示 Index 身份，不声称合并／变基归属。缺失阶段显示为空，不推断内容；不读取工作文件，不解决冲突。
zh.conflictStageGitlink: 子模块提交引用，不加载内容
zh.conflictStageMissing: 所选阶段缺失，按空内容比较；不推断原始内容。
zh.binary: 二进制或受限内容无法按文本比较
zh.stale: 内容发生变化，请刷新后重试。
zh.scanHint: 仅扫描当前目录及一级子目录，不递归深入 · 缓存 5 分钟后过期
zh.truncated: 已达到扫描上限。输入相对子目录并重新扫描以补充其他位置。
zh.fallback: 高级编辑器不可用，已切换为基础左右文本对比。
zh.approximate: 内容较大，使用近似行对齐。
zh.commitSignatureUnverified: 仅检测签名头，未做信任验证。
zh.stashScope: 仅读取本地 refs/stash，列出已暂存的工作区快照；选择后复用提交详情只读查看其差异。此视图不支持跨提交导航，路径历史与 Blame 提交仅显示为文字；来源行文件预览仍可使用。不创建、应用、删除或弹出 stash。
zh.grepScope: 在固定的 HEAD 提交树中分页进行字面文本搜索；每页最多100条，扫描、文件与输出容量有界。可能出现无命中的续查页；跳过或受限内容会明确提示。只读，不搜索未提交改动，不联网。
zh.commitNoChanges: 相对此基线无文件变更
zh.workspaceLargeScope: Git工作区完整文本比较，支持UTF-8、GBK及带BOM的UTF-16；每侧8MiB／10万行。读取期间变化会拒绝结果，成功后文件仍可被外部修改。
zh.largeScope: 仅Git历史普通文本文件，支持UTF-8、GBK及带BOM的UTF-16；每侧最多8MiB、10万行。不是工作区或SVN大文件。
zh.diffPending: 正在计算差异，尚不能判断是否相同。
zh.diffIncomplete: 差异计算未完成或超时，当前结果可能不完整。
zh.largeFallback: 基础视图只展示有界片段，不代表完整大文件差异。
zh.historyListOnly: 本地 HEAD 历史；选择提交及文件查看只读文本差异。
zh.historyRefsScope: 标记来自最近一次手动加载的本地引用，不代表提交创建时的分支状态；刷新失败时保留上次成功结果。
zh.historySearch: 筛选已加载提交（作者 / 摘要 / SHA）
zh.historyNoMatch: 已加载提交中无匹配项；可继续加载更多。
zh.historyNavigationScope: 从某个提交的文件历史或 Blame 跳转到另一个提交后，“返回上一处”会回到跳转前的提交，并尝试预选唯一完全匹配的路径；这是本会话内的页面上下文，不读取或写入仓库。
zh.historyLimit: 已达到历史浏览范围上限，仍有更早提交未显示。
zh.autoRefresh: 手动或窗口聚焦时刷新
zh.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F 搜索；Esc 清空搜索
zh.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → 切换上一个或下一个文件
zh.pathCopied: 文件路径已复制到剪贴板。
zh.revisionTitle: 本地版本 A/B 比较
zh.revisionScope: 可选择已加载的提交，或手动加载本地分支与标签；直接比较 A → B，不使用合并基点。
zh.revisionEmpty: 两个版本没有文件变更。
zh.fileHistoryDateScope: 可选时间边界按提交时间(committer date)含边界过滤；与“跟随重命名”不能同时使用，报错后取消其一即可。
zh.submoduleCheckout_initialized: 存在本地Git标记（未验证检出有效性）
zh.submodulePointerMoved: 指针已移动（检出HEAD与记录不同）
zh.submoduleScope: 预览显示Index记录的提交指针与本地Git标记存在状态；已初始化检出时，来自父仓库自身 git status 的指针移动／未提交改动／未跟踪内容会一并标注，不进入子模块、不额外解析其HEAD、不加载内容、不更新或同步。
zh.pathHistoryScope: 手动读取所选历史路径在该提交下的文件历史；路径必须存在于该提交。关闭跟随时不跨重命名。
zh.pathHistoryFollowScope: 跟随沿用同一保守规则：第一父链、Git相似度至少50%、每次确认唯一删除／新增来源，歧义、复制或32次确认上限处停止；只适用于提交中的普通文件或链接。
zh.fileHistoryScope: 固定提交快照下的精确路径历史；不追踪重命名前路径，包含同路径删除后重建。点击提交后，仅在相对首个父提交（根提交为空树）的变更中唯一匹配同路径时打开 Diff；否则只显示详情。
zh.blameNavigation: 点击归属提交查看详情；有精确来源路径及行号时，打开固定提交文件并尝试在高级或基础视图定位该行，较大 UTF-8 文件可手动打开分段定位。没有行号时仅预选变更中路径完全一致的唯一文件，不猜测旧路径或缺失映射；越界或不支持内容会明确提示。
zh.blameScope: 所选提交的 UTF-8 普通文本，每页最多 500 行，可切换行页；不包含工作区修改。
zh.blameLimit: 当前行页已达到显示上限；若有下一页，可继续读取。
zh.historicalTreeScope: 所选提交的目录条目；每页 100 项。点击普通文件只读预览；不跟随符号链接或子模块。
zh.treeEmpty: 空文件或无可显示的文本。
zh.graphScope: 仅展示已加载历史的前 200 个提交，最多 1000 条父子边；不受文本筛选影响，不代表完整分支图。节点点击可查看详情。
zh.graphLimit: 图已达到节点或边上限，部分关系未展示。
zh.graphInvalid: 当前提交顺序无法绘图；请使用历史列表。
zh.imageCompositeUnavailable: 两侧图片均成功加载后才能叠加比较；缺失、加载中或失败的图片不能参与比较，可在相应侧重试。
zh.imageRegistration: 按原始像素比例左上角对齐，共用最大宽高画布；不同尺寸不会拉伸为相同大小。
zh.imageCompare: PNG / JPEG / WebP 图片比较
zh.imageMetadata: 预览已移除附加元数据。
zh.imageScope: 支持非交错静态 PNG、8位基线/渐进 JPEG 普通文件，以及单块静态VP8／无损VP8L WebP（不支持算术编码/CMYK JPEG、扩展/动画 WebP）；每侧最多 2 MiB、1600 万像素。元数据被移除，不适用于色彩精确性审阅。支持历史提交、固定 A/B 及 Git 工作区；按所选模式读取 HEAD、暂存区或工作文件。冲突图片不支持。
zh.commitMessageLimit: 完整提交说明超过 2 MiB 预览上限，已省略。
zh.revisionLoadRefs: 加载 / 刷新本地分支与标签
zh.revisionRefsScope: 本地分支、指向提交的标签及本地缓存的远程跟踪引用，共最多1000条；不连接远端或fetch，远程缓存可能过期。重新加载时，origin/HEAD 显示它当前指向的本地提交；已选历史和版本仍固定。选择固定为加载时的提交 OID；刷新引用不会移动已选版本。
zh.revisionRefsEmpty: 没有可用的本地分支或提交标签。
zh.reloadInterface: 检查并加载已安装更新
zh.reloadDone: 已重新加载 VCS 界面；旧请求、编辑器及 SVN 授权已清理。
zh.reloadRestart: 已安装更新涉及后端，请自行重启 DSH 后刷新页面。
zh.reloadFailed: 加载失败，已保留原界面；请重试或重启 DSH。
zh.updateScope: 此按钮不自动安装。请在插件管理器中检查安装方式；当前宿主可能要求先卸载再安装。也可在终端按实际 profile 和已核验版本执行以下命令。
zh.updateRestart: 安装后点击“检查并加载已安装更新”。仅在后端指纹一致时加载新界面；否则提示重启。不自动重启 DSH。
zh.linePlan: 新建 / 重新规划逐行选择
zh.lineReadonly: 规划和预览均只读，不写对象或索引。每个删除与插入独立选择，不自动配对替换。行号从 1 开始；⟦LF⟧、⟦CRLF⟧、⟦CR⟧ 是原始换行，⟦NONE⟧ 表示无末尾换行。
zh.lineSemantics: 保留未选删除的旧行，然后按目标顺序添加所选插入；不自动替换或合成换行。不安全的行融合由服务器拒绝，必须重新规划。
zh.lineConsumed: 规划已消耗（包括失败）；选择已锁定。修改选择必须重新规划并丢弃旧候选令牌。
zh.lineExpired: 令牌已过期，未发送写请求；请重新规划。
zh.lineInvalid: 逐行响应无效或超出安全边界；请重新规划。
zh.lineTarget: 合成候选目标索引条目
zh.lineScopeStage: Git 普通修改，支持 空格 M 及 MM；I → W，保留未选索引、工作文件和 HEAD。拒绝二进制、无效 UTF-8、增删、重命名、链接、子模块、过滤器及 Git attributes。每侧最多 256 KiB、4000 行、4000 个精确原始块、8000 个操作；精确 LCS 最多 200000 格。全工作树扫描每文件 2 MiB、合计 16 MiB，超限拒绝。
zh.lineWarningStage: 核对 I → W、所选操作、完整对象 ID 与模式。候选由捕获的 Index 和捕获的工作文件原始字节合成，不一定等于工作文件 blob。仅最终确认写索引并复验全新工作树 W；变化必须重新规划。合成 blob 仅追加（append-only），失败或取消可能留下孤立对象，不执行 GC 或回滚。不编辑工作文件或 HEAD。发送确认后取消或离开不保证撤销；结果未知必须显式刷新核对。
zh.lineAcknowledgeStage: 我已核对 I → W 逐行操作及合成候选索引，确认仅应用所选操作
zh.lineScopeUnstage: Git 普通修改，支持 M 空格 及 MM；I → H，保留未选索引、工作文件和 HEAD。拒绝二进制、无效 UTF-8、增删、重命名、链接、子模块、过滤器及 Git attributes。每侧最多 256 KiB、4000 行、4000 个精确原始块、8000 个操作；精确 LCS 最多 200000 格。全工作树扫描每文件 2 MiB、合计 16 MiB，超限拒绝。
zh.lineWarningUnstage: 核对 I → H、所选操作、完整对象 ID 与模式。候选由捕获的 Index 和固定 HEAD原始字节合成，不一定等于HEAD blob。仅最终确认写索引并复验全新工作树 W；变化必须重新规划。合成 blob 仅追加（append-only），失败或取消可能留下孤立对象，不执行 GC 或回滚。不编辑工作文件或 HEAD。发送确认后取消或离开不保证撤销；结果未知必须显式刷新核对。
zh.lineAcknowledgeUnstage: 我已核对 I → H 逐行操作及合成候选索引，确认仅应用所选操作
zh.lineConfirmUnstage: 最终确认逐行取消暂存

en.lightweightTagScope: Git workspace only. Create a lightweight tag directly referencing fixed server current HEAD commit: no tag object, tagger or message. Strict configuration refuses hooks, packed-refs, filters and unsupported states. No overwrite, signing, push or checkout; no worktree or index changes.
en.lightweightTagBounds: Exact portable short name: at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes total / 255 per component. Refuse HEAD, refs/, controls and Windows reserved names. No normalization, OID / ref, tagger or message inputs. Candidate TTL at most 61 seconds.
en.lightweightTagAcknowledge: I checked the complete candidate: lightweight tag directly at fixed HEAD commit, no tag object
en.lightweightTagWarning: Lightweight tag directly references the commit, not an annotated tag: no tag object, tagger or message. No overwrite, signing, push or checkout; HEAD and current branch stay unchanged. No global external atomicity guarantee, automatic retry or rollback.
en.lightweightTagPending: Lightweight tag confirmation sent; awaiting verification.
en.lightweightTagUnknown: Lightweight tag / repository mutation outcome unknown. Cancellation, leaving or disconnecting does not guarantee undo. No automatic retry, overwrite or rollback. Explicitly rediscover and inspect refs and HEAD before writing again.
en.lightweightTagRecover: Explicitly rediscover after checking refs / HEAD
en.lightweightTagInvalid: Invalid lightweight tag response or mismatch with fixed candidate and exact name.
en.lightweightTagInvalidDraft: Enter an exact portable short name (1000 total / 255 per component UTF-8 bytes).
en.lightweightTagExpired: Lightweight tag candidate expired; explicitly prepare again. No automatic retry.
en.tagCreateScope: Git workspace only: unsigned annotated tag at fixed server current HEAD. Strict configuration refuses hooks, packed-refs, filters and unsupported states. No overwrite, signing, push or checkout; no worktree or index changes.
en.tagCreateBounds: Exact short name: at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes total / 255 per component. Explicit identity name/email: 1024 bytes each; nonnegative safe-integer Unix seconds and ±HHMM timezone up to ±1400. Nonblank strict UTF-8 message: 65536 bytes, CR/LF/TAB preserved, other controls and PGP signature markers refused. Candidate TTL at most 61 seconds. No automatic identity lookup/reuse or normalization.
en.tagCreateAcknowledge: I checked the complete candidate: unsigned annotated tag at current HEAD only
en.tagCreateWarning: Unsigned annotated tag only: no overwrite, signing, push or checkout. Target is fixed preview HEAD; HEAD and current branch stay unchanged. No global external atomicity guarantee, automatic retry or rollback.
en.tagCreateUnknown: Tag creation outcome unknown; do not retry. Check tag refs and HEAD before explicit refresh/rediscovery.
en.tagCreateInvalid: Invalid tag candidate/result or mismatch with exact submitted name, identity or message.
en.tagCreateInvalidDraft: Enter a portable short name, explicit full identity (Unix seconds and ±HHMM), and nonblank strict UTF-8 message.
en.tagCreateExpired: Tag candidate expired; explicitly prepare again.
en.branchDeletePreviewTitle: Read-only branch deletion assessment (no deletion performed)
en.branchDeletePreviewScope: Git workspace assessment only. No force deletion or actual deletion support. Unmerged branches and unsupported repository states are rejected, never bypassed.
en.branchDeletePreviewBounds: Enter the exact short name, without normalization: at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes total and 255 bytes per path component.
en.branchDeletePreviewConstraints: Only backend-verified current branch and direct loose target refs are supported; packed-refs, shared metadata, hooks and other unsupported states are rejected. Observation barriers are not a globally atomic snapshot and cannot prevent raw-ref-type races or mutation-and-restoration.
en.branchDeletePreviewInvalidDraft: Enter a portable exact short branch name (1000 total / 255 per-component UTF-8 bytes).
en.branchDeletePreviewInvalid: Invalid branch assessment response or mismatch with submitted name.
en.branchDeletePreviewBlocked: Repository write pending or outcome unknown; assessment is blocked to avoid stale state.
en.branchDeletePreviewWarning: No deletion performed. Merged proof is not deletion permission, grants no authority and does not guarantee later ref freshness.
en.branchCreateScope: Git workspace only. Strict configuration rejects hooks, packed-refs, filters and unsupported states; never bypass rejection or overwrite an existing branch. Creates a local ref at fixed current HEAD only; no automatic checkout, worktree or index changes.
en.branchCreateBounds: Exact short name: at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes total and 255 per component. Reject HEAD, refs/, controls, Windows reserved names and nonportable names. Candidate TTL at most 61 seconds. No OID / ref input or automatic normalization.
en.branchCreateAcknowledge: I checked the full candidate and agree to create only, without switching branches
en.branchCreateWarning: Create only: no overwrite, checkout or automatic branch switch. HEAD and current branch remain unchanged. No global external atomicity guarantee, automatic retry or rollback.
en.branchCreatePending: Branch creation confirmation sent; awaiting verification.
en.branchCreateExpired: Expired candidate discarded; explicitly prepare again. No automatic retry.
en.branchCreateInvalid: Invalid branch creation response or mismatch with fixed candidate.
en.branchCreateInvalidDraft: Enter an exact portable short branch name (1000 total / 255 per component UTF-8 bytes).
en.branchCreateUnknown: Branch creation / repository mutation outcome unknown. Cancellation, leaving or disconnecting does not guarantee undo. No automatic retry, overwrite or rollback. Explicitly rediscover and inspect refs and HEAD before writing again.
en.branchCreateRecover: Explicitly rediscover and inspect refs / HEAD
en.amendTitle: Explicit amend — HISTORY REWRITE (not a new child commit)
en.amendScope: Git loaded staged index only, including an empty changes list for message-only amend. Retains the original author and ALL parents (root: zero); neither is client input. Strict backend refusals include signed commits, packed-refs, hooks, filters / encoding conversion, attributes, links, submodules, conflicts and unsupported states. No bypass.
en.amendDefaults: Enter committer and exact plaintext message explicitly. Names start blank; browser time and timezone are editable. No identity lookup or original-message autoload. Limits: name/email 1024 UTF-8 bytes each, message 65536 bytes, at most 16 unique parents, candidate lifetime at most 61 seconds.
en.amendWarning: HISTORY REWRITE: replaces the current branch HEAD, not a new child commit. Confirm the old HEAD, previous tree, original author, ALL parents, new tree and replacement commit. Preparation/cancel writes no objects; confirmation writes append-only objects then updates the branch, not worktree/index. Orphan objects may remain. No global external atomicity, automatic retry/rerun, rollback, GC or force-push.
en.amendAcknowledge: I checked the complete replacement and explicitly accept rewriting current branch history
en.amendExpired: Expired candidate discarded; no automatic retry. Prepare again explicitly.
en.amendInvalid: Invalid amend response or mismatch with captured candidate.
en.amendInvalidDraft: Enter valid explicit committer (all four fields) and bounded plaintext message.
en.amendUnknown: Amend outcome unknown. Do not retry, rerun, rollback or force-push automatically. Explicitly rediscover and inspect HEAD, branch and index before another write.
en.commitLatestScope: Explicitly read the fixed HEAD commit of the current branch; draft, candidate and acknowledgement stay unchanged.
en.commitLatestInvalid: Latest commit response is invalid or exceeds safety bounds.
en.commitLatestReuseNotice: Explicit reuse copies only the exact message (including CRLF, BOM and empty messages), never author or committer. This creates a NEW commit, not amend. Text unsupported by the write policy stays in the draft but prepare rejects it; line endings are never normalized.
en.commitPending: Final confirmation sent; waiting to verify.
en.commitAcknowledge: I verified the full candidate, explicit identities and exact message and confirm updating the branch
en.commitExpired: Token expired and discarded; no automatic retry. Prepare a new candidate.
en.commitInvalid: Invalid commit response or mismatch with captured candidate.
en.commitInvalidDraft: Enter explicit name/email (each at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no controls or angle brackets), nonnegative safe-integer epoch seconds, ±HHMM timezone (maximum ±1400, minutes below 60), and nonblank plaintext message (at most 64 KiB; only LF/tab controls).
en.commitDefaults: Names and emails start blank. No Git configuration or automatic identity RPC. Browser epoch seconds and timezone are editable defaults only: verify form and preview. Author and committer are independent. Exact message and final newline are preserved.
en.commitScope: Git ordinary staged index modifications, additions and deletions only; not stage-all, amend or push. Strict backend refusals: signed parent commits, packed-refs, hooks, filters / encoding conversion, attributes, links, submodules, conflicts and other unsupported states. No bypass and no global atomicity against all external processes.
en.commitWarning: Read-only preparation and cancelling a candidate do not write objects. Final confirmation revalidates captured HEAD, ref, index digest and metadata; writes tree/commit objects append-only and updates the branch without modifying worktree or index. Failure / cancellation may leave orphan objects; no GC, rollback or automatic retry. Not global external atomicity.
en.commitUnknown: Commit / index confirmation outcome unknown. Cancelling, leaving or disconnecting after sending does not guarantee reversal; append-only orphan objects may remain. Explicitly refresh and inspect HEAD and index before preparing again. Never retry automatically or roll back.
en.indexMutationPending: This repository has a pending HEAD / index confirmation or unknown outcome. Wait and explicitly refresh to inspect HEAD and index.
en.partialUnstageScope: Git staged ordinary modifications (M space or MM). Reverse restoration: current Index → pinned HEAD for selected units, preserving unselected index changes and working files. No worktree edits. Whole-file unstage still rejects MM. No binary, invalid UTF-8, additions, deletions, renames, links, submodules, filters or Git attributes. Each side: 256 KiB, 4000 lines, 4000 units; exact LCS: 200000 cells. Whole-tree scan: 2 MiB per file, 16 MiB total. Limits reject, never truncate.
en.partialUnstageReadonly: Planning and selection previews are read-only: no objects or index writes. Select entire exact raw-line units only; replacements are atomic, not arbitrary line edits. Displayed coordinates are 1-based. ⟦LF⟧, ⟦CRLF⟧ and ⟦CR⟧ mark original endings; ⟦NONE⟧ means no final newline.
en.partialUnstageConsumed: Plan consumed; selection locked. To change selection, create a NEW plan; the old confirmation token will be discarded.
en.partialUnstageWarning: Verify Index → HEAD restoration units, full object IDs and modes. The candidate is a synthetic index blob built from captured current Index and pinned HEAD raw bytes, not working-file bytes and not necessarily the HEAD blob. Only final confirmation writes the index and saves append-only blob objects; even unstaging can leave orphan blobs on cancellation or failure, with no GC or rollback. Confirmation revalidates the worktree; changes require replanning. No working-file or HEAD edits. Cancelling or leaving after sending confirmation does not guarantee undo.
en.partialUnstageAcknowledge: I verified Index → HEAD restoration units and the synthetic candidate index and confirm unstaging only selected units
en.partialUnstageExpired: Token expired; no write request sent. Create a NEW plan.
en.partialUnstageInvalid: Invalid or out-of-bounds block unstaging response. Create a NEW plan.
en.partialScope: Git unstaged ordinary modifications (space M or MM). Plans use the current Index and preserve existing staged changes. Whole-file actions still reject MM. No binary, invalid UTF-8, additions, deletions, renames, links, submodules, filters or Git attributes. Each input: at most 256 KiB and 4000 lines; at most 4000 units; exact LCS after common prefix/suffix removal: 200000 cells. Repository scan: 2 MiB per file, 16 MiB total, including ignored and untracked files. Limits reject, never silently truncate.
en.partialReadonly: Planning and selection previews are read-only: no objects or index writes. Select entire exact raw-line units only; replacements are atomic, not arbitrary line edits. Displayed coordinates are 1-based. ⟦LF⟧, ⟦CRLF⟧ and ⟦CR⟧ mark original endings; ⟦NONE⟧ means no final newline.
en.partialConsumed: Plan consumed; selection locked. To change selection, create a NEW plan; the old confirmation token will be discarded.
en.partialWarning: Verify selected units, full object IDs and modes before confirmation. Confirmation stages only selected atomic units captured in the plan, from captured plan bytes; confirmation rereads and revalidates the worktree, and changes require replanning rather than replacing the candidate; worktree and HEAD are unchanged. Only final confirmation saves append-only blob objects; cancellation or failure may leave orphan blobs, with no GC or rollback. Cancelling or leaving after sending confirmation does not guarantee undo.
en.partialAcknowledge: I verified the exact raw units and candidate index and confirm staging only selected units
en.partialExpired: Token expired; no write request sent. Create a NEW plan.
en.partialInvalid: Invalid or out-of-bounds block staging response. Create a NEW plan.
en.stageScope: Only ordinary modified files (space M) selected in Git unstaged mode are supported. No MM or partial staging, additions, deletions, renames, submodules or links. Preparation scans the whole working tree, including ignored and untracked files: at most 2 MiB per file and 16 MiB total. Filters and Git attributes are unsupported. The server rejects unsupported repositories; limits are never silently skipped.
en.stageWarning: Confirmation stages only the bytes captured during preparation, not newer working-file contents. Working files and HEAD are unchanged. Verify the full object IDs and modes. Preparation and cancelling a preview do not write objects. After confirmation is sent, execution stores an append-only blob; cancellation may then leave an unreferenced orphan blob, with no GC or rollback. Cancelling or leaving after sending does not guarantee undo.
en.stageTarget: Target index entry for captured bytes
en.stageAcknowledge: I verified the preview and confirm staging only the captured bytes of this file
en.stageExpired: Confirmation expired; no write request was sent. Prepare again.
en.stagePending: Staging request sent; do not repeat the operation.
en.stageUnknown: The commit / index operation outcome is unknown; the token was discarded and will not be retried. Commit, staging and unstaging are blocked. Append-only orphan objects may remain; no rollback. Explicitly refresh this same actual repository and inspect HEAD and index before deciding what to do next.
en.unstageScope: Only ordinary modified files (M space) in Git staged mode are supported; no MM or partial staging, additions/deletions, renames, submodules or links. Preflight scans the whole working tree, including ignored/untracked files: 2 MiB per file, 16 MiB total. Filters and Git attributes are unsupported. The server rejects unsupported repositories; limits are not silently skipped.
en.unstageWarning: Confirmation restores only this file’s index entry to HEAD; working files and HEAD are unchanged. Check the independent preview’s full object IDs and modes. Cancelling or leaving after sending cannot guarantee rollback.
en.unstageAcknowledge: I checked the preview and explicitly confirm unstaging only this file
en.unstageExpired: Confirmation expired; no write was sent. Prepare a new preview.
en.unstagePending: Unstage request sent; do not repeat the operation.
en.unstageUnknown: The commit / index operation outcome is unknown; the token was discarded and will not be retried. Commit, staging and unstaging are blocked. Append-only orphan objects may remain; no rollback. Explicitly refresh this same actual repository and inspect HEAD and index before deciding what to do next.
en.reflogScope: Read-only local reference log snapshot: at most 200 entries, with no pagination. Select an entry to inspect its returned fixed commit, not a moving reference. Viewing only: no restore, reset or write operations are provided.
en.reflogTruncated: Only the latest 200 entries were returned; this is not the complete reflog.
en.reflogEmpty: No reference log entries are available.
en.grepPageLimit: This page reached its display budget; continue to read more.
en.grepScanBudget: This page reached its scan budget; continue to scan more.
en.grepUnsupported: Files exceeding the per-file budget were not searched.
en.grepTextTruncated: Long matching line: only its beginning is shown. Open the file to read the match.
en.segmentLocalCoordinates: Segment-local line numbers only; this host did not provide global coordinates, so the requested line cannot be located.
en.grepInvalid: Invalid search response or changed snapshot. Start a new search.
en.grepComplete: Fixed snapshot search exhausted; the count is for this page only.
en.grepMoreAvailable: More remains to scan; the count is for this page only.
en.grepPartial: Search ended with limited or skipped content; results are incomplete.
en.grepEmptyPage: No matches on this page; more content remains to scan.
en.readingTargetMissing: Requested line is not in the available text
en.segmentPartialLine: A segment boundary may contain only part of a line
en.reviewWithBranchSwitch: Read-only review · Git operations require confirmation
en.branchScope: This changes the actual working copy, not the history filter. Existing local branches only. Read and preflight first, then verify source and target commits before confirming. Updates HEAD, index and working files; no force, auto-stash, branch creation or network. Dirty or unsupported repositories are rejected by the host.
en.branchWarning: Confirmation changes the actual branch, index and working files. Save editor contents first. This confirmation is single-use and is never retried automatically. Leaving while it runs does not guarantee cancellation.
en.branchExpired: Confirmation expired; no switch request was sent. Preflight again.
en.branchPending: Switch request sent. Do not repeat the operation or leave the page.
en.branchUnknown: The switch outcome is unknown. This token has been discarded and will not be retried. Read the actual repository and refresh the working copy before deciding what to do next.
en.branchRecover: Read again and refresh working copy
en.branchInvalid: Invalid or incomplete branch response; read again.
en.svnOfferExpired: Network access offer expired. Retry manually and check consent again.
en.svnExpired: SVN network consent expired; history requests stopped. Review and consent again.
en.svnConsentScope: Before consent, read local identity only. Access binds this repository, Session and cwd for five minutes; redirects and writes are not authorized.
en.svnConsentExplicit: I consent to access the HTTPS SVN repository above
en.svnHistoryScope: SVN history at a fixed revision snapshot; retain up to 200 rows, load more or go back
en.svnHistoryDateScope: Bounded in-window date filter on the svn:date day portion; SVN REPORT supports revision ranges only, so cross-window completeness is never claimed.
en.svnCopyOutside: Copy source is outside the authorized scope
en.svnCopyTraceScope: Separate fixed in-scope source history, stopping at its copy boundary; not automatic tracing
en.svnTraceScope: File trace stops at copy boundaries and does not follow out-of-scope sources
en.svnGrantScope: Network consent lasts five minutes; revoke at any time. History operations do not modify the working copy.
en.svnOfflineIdentity: Read local metadata from the authorized working copy only; no remote request.
en.svnRemoteDisabled: Remote SVN history transport is not enabled; no network grant or usable access token. This is not an authorized history entry point.
en.historyWindow: Loaded history window (start inclusive, end exclusive)
en.historyWindowScope: List and graph retain at most 200 rows; more loads replace newer rows. Boundary edges are not a complete graph. Local filtering covers this window only.
en.segmentScope: Committed UTF-8 regular files up to 16 MiB; replaceable 64 KiB segments with original global line numbers and target-line location. Segment boundaries may split a line; this is not a full-file Diff.
en.blameUnmapped: Origin line cannot be located precisely
en.fileHistoryMergeBoundary: Identity boundary: merge commit; stopped without inferring parent origin
en.fileHistoryAmbiguous: Multiple candidate origins; tracing stopped here
en.fileHistoryRenameLimit: 32 rename confirmations reached; tracing stopped here
en.fileHistoryBoundary: Identity boundary: copy or inexact rename; stopped here
en.fileHistoryFollowScope: Git-detected renames; similarities of 50% or more require a unique deletion/addition transition. Stops at ambiguity, copies and merges. Similarity is not an identity guarantee; rows use historical paths.
en.graphLaneLimit: At most 32 lanes. Overflow geometry is omitted; loaded nodes and relations remain available as text.
en.historyBranchScope: Load references manually below. Selection pins that OID; refreshing references does not move the history tip. Selecting HEAD reads current HEAD without checking out.
en.historyServerScope: Search all history reachable from the pinned snapshot. Message/author use case-insensitive literal matching; path is an exact path or directory, without rename following. Date bounds filter on committer date inclusively and use --since-as-filter to avoid early termination on non-monotonic history; boundary dates without a timezone use the runner local zone. Pagination and runtime are bounded.
en.title: VCS changes
en.noSession: Open a project session to inspect its changes.
en.noRepo: No Git / SVN repositories discovered. Try a relative subdirectory and rescan.
en.conflictStagesScope: Manually reads Index stages 1/2/3 of the selected conflict. Stage numbers are Index identities, not merge/rebase ownership claims. Missing stages show as empty and are never inferred; the working file is not read and the conflict is not resolved.
en.conflictStageGitlink: submodule commit reference, contents not loaded
en.conflictStageMissing: A selected stage is absent, so it is compared as empty; original content is not inferred.
en.binary: Binary or restricted content cannot be compared as text
en.stale: Content changed. Refresh and try again.
en.scanHint: Scan current directory and immediate children only · cache expires after 5 minutes
en.truncated: Discovery limit reached. Enter a relative subdirectory and rescan to include another location.
en.fallback: Advanced editor unavailable. Showing basic side-by-side text comparison.
en.textTruncated: Only the first 2000 lines are displayed.
en.stashScope: Reads local refs/stash and reuses commit details for read-only diffs. Cross-commit navigation is not supported here: path-history and Blame commits are plain text; origin-line file previews remain available. Never creates, applies, drops, or pops a stash.
en.grepScope: Paged literal-text search in a fixed HEAD commit tree, up to 100 matches per page with bounded scan, file and output budgets. An empty page may have more to scan; skipped or limited content is reported. Read-only; no uncommitted changes or network.
en.commitNoChanges: No file changes against this baseline
en.workspaceLargeScope: Complete Git working-copy text comparison supports UTF-8, GBK and BOM-marked UTF-16; 8 MiB / 100000 lines per side. Changes during loading reject the result; external edits remain possible afterward.
en.largeScope: Git historical regular text files support UTF-8, GBK and BOM-marked UTF-16; at most 8 MiB and 100000 lines per side. Not working-copy or SVN large files.
en.diffPending: Computing differences; equality is not yet known.
en.diffIncomplete: Difference computation is incomplete or timed out; displayed results may be partial.
en.largeFallback: The basic view shows bounded excerpts, not the complete large-file diff.
en.historyListOnly: Local HEAD history. Select a commit and file to view a read-only text diff.
en.historyRefsScope: Labels reflect the last manually loaded local refs, not branches at commit creation. Failed refreshes retain the last successful result.
en.historyNoMatch: No matches in loaded commits; you can load more if available.
en.historyNavigationScope: After jumping from one commit's file history or Blame into another commit, “Back” returns to the commit you came from and tries to preselect the single exactly matching path; this is in-page context and reads or writes no repository state.
en.historyLimit: History browsing limit reached; older commits are not shown.
en.autoRefresh: Refresh manually or on window focus
en.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F to search; Esc clears search
en.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → switches the previous or next file
en.pathCopied: File path copied to the clipboard.
en.copyFailed: Unable to copy the file path.
en.revisionScope: Choose loaded commits or manually load local branches and tags. Compare A → B directly, not via merge-base.
en.revisionEmpty: No file changes between these revisions.
en.fileHistoryDateScope: Optional date bounds filter on committer date inclusively; they cannot combine with rename following, so disable one if an error appears.
en.submoduleCheckout_initialized: local Git marker present (checkout validity not verified)
en.submodulePointerMoved: pointer moved (checkout HEAD differs from recorded)
en.submoduleScope: The preview shows the Index-recorded pointer and local Git-marker presence; for an initialized checkout, pointer movement, uncommitted changes and untracked content reported by the parent repository's own git status are annotated, without entering the submodule, separately resolving its HEAD, loading contents, or updating anything.
en.pathHistoryScope: Manually reads the file history of the selected historical path at that commit; the path must exist in that commit. Without following, renames are not crossed.
en.pathHistoryFollowScope: Following uses the same conservative rules: first parent, Git similarity of at least 50%, a unique deletion/addition confirmed each time, stopping at ambiguity, copies or the 32-confirmation cap; only committed regular files or links are supported.
en.fileHistoryScope: Exact-path history at the pinned commit; no rename following, including deletion and recreation. Selecting a commit opens its Diff only for a unique same-path change against the first parent (empty tree for a root); otherwise only details are shown.
en.blameNavigation: Select an attributed commit to view details. Exact origin paths and lines open the pinned file in advanced or basic mode; larger UTF-8 files can be opened manually as located segments. Without a line, only a unique same-path change is preselected; old paths and missing mappings are not guessed. Out-of-range or unsupported content is reported.
en.blameScope: UTF-8 regular text at the selected commit, at most 500 lines per page with line-page navigation. Working changes are excluded.
en.blameLimit: The current line page reached its display limit; continue if a next page is available.
en.historicalTreeScope: Entries at the selected commit; 100 per page. Select regular files for read-only preview; symlinks and submodules are not followed.
en.treeEmpty: Empty file or no displayable text.
en.graphScope: First 200 loaded commits, at most 1000 parent edges. Independent of text filtering; not a complete branch graph. Select a node for details.
en.graphLimit: Node or edge limit reached; some relationships are omitted.
en.graphInvalid: Cannot graph this commit order; use the history list.
en.imageCompositeUnavailable: Both images must load successfully for a composite comparison. Loading, absent or failed sides cannot be compared; retry on the affected side.
en.imageRegistration: Top-left registration at original pixel ratios on a shared maximum-width/height canvas; different sizes are not stretched to match.
en.imageMetadata: Ancillary metadata was removed from this preview.
en.imageScope: Non-interlaced static PNG, 8-bit baseline or progressive JPEG regular files, or single-chunk static VP8 / lossless VP8L WebP (no arithmetic-coded/CMYK JPEG or extended/animated WebP); at most 2 MiB and 16 million pixels per side. Metadata is removed; not suitable for color-critical review. Supports commits, fixed A/B and Git working changes; HEAD, index or working bytes follow the selected mode. Conflicted images are unsupported.
en.commitMessageLimit: Full commit message exceeds the 2 MiB preview limit and was omitted.
en.revisionLoadRefs: Load / refresh local branches and tags
en.revisionRefsScope: Local branches, commit tags and locally cached remote-tracking refs, at most 1000 total; no network or fetch. Remote caches may be stale. Reloading origin/HEAD shows its current local target; selected history and versions stay pinned. Selections pin the loaded commit OID; refreshing refs does not move selected versions.
en.revisionRefsEmpty: No local branches or commit tags are available.
en.reloadDone: VCS interface reloaded; old requests, editors and SVN grants were cleaned up.
en.reloadRestart: Installed update changes the backend. Restart DSH and refresh the page.
en.reloadFailed: Reload failed. Previous interface retained; retry or restart DSH.
en.updateScope: This button does not install packages. Check installation options in the plugin manager; this host may require uninstalling before reinstalling. Alternatively run this command with your actual profile and verified version.
en.updateRestart: After installation, check and load the installed update. Reload is allowed only when backend fingerprints match; otherwise restart DSH manually. DSH is never restarted automatically.
en.lineReadonly: Plan and preview are read-only; no object or index writes. Each deletion and insertion is independent, never an automatic replacement. Coordinates are 1-based; ⟦LF⟧, ⟦CRLF⟧, ⟦CR⟧ mark raw endings; ⟦NONE⟧ means no final newline.
en.lineSemantics: Retain unselected old lines, then append selected inserts in target order. No automatic replacement or synthesized newline. Server rejects unsafe line fusion; replan required.
en.lineConsumed: Plan consumed (including on failure); selection locked. Replan to change selection, discarding old candidate token.
en.lineExpired: Token expired; no write request sent. Replan.
en.lineInvalid: Invalid or out-of-bounds line-selection response. Replan.
en.lineScopeStage: Git ordinary modified files (space-M or MM); I → W, preserving unselected index, working files and HEAD. Rejects binary, invalid UTF-8, additions/deletions, renames, links, submodules, filters and Git attributes. Each side: 256 KiB, 4000 lines, 4000 exact raw blocks; 8000 operations; exact LCS 200000 cells. Whole working-tree scan: 2 MiB/file, 16 MiB total; over-limit inputs rejected.
en.lineWarningStage: Verify I → W, selected operations, full object IDs and modes. Synthetic candidate uses captured Index and captured working-file raw bytes, not necessarily the working-file blob. Only final confirmation writes index and revalidates fresh W; changes require replanning. Synthetic blob storage is append-only; failure/cancellation may leave orphan objects, no GC or rollback. Working files and HEAD are not edited. Cancel/leaving after confirmation does not guarantee rollback; unknown outcomes require explicit refresh.
en.lineAcknowledgeStage: I verified I → W operations and synthetic candidate index; apply only selected operations
en.lineScopeUnstage: Git ordinary modified files (M-space or MM); I → H, preserving unselected index, working files and HEAD. Rejects binary, invalid UTF-8, additions/deletions, renames, links, submodules, filters and Git attributes. Each side: 256 KiB, 4000 lines, 4000 exact raw blocks; 8000 operations; exact LCS 200000 cells. Whole working-tree scan: 2 MiB/file, 16 MiB total; over-limit inputs rejected.
en.lineWarningUnstage: Verify I → H, selected operations, full object IDs and modes. Synthetic candidate uses captured Index and pinned HEAD raw bytes, not necessarily the HEAD blob. Only final confirmation writes index and revalidates fresh W; changes require replanning. Synthetic blob storage is append-only; failure/cancellation may leave orphan objects, no GC or rollback. Working files and HEAD are not edited. Cancel/leaving after confirmation does not guarantee rollback; unknown outcomes require explicit refresh.
en.lineAcknowledgeUnstage: I verified I → H operations and synthetic candidate index; apply only selected operations
